subject: eng
title: Present Simple vs Present Continuous: every day / now
goal: Ти навчишся розрізняти Present Simple (щодня, зазвичай) і Present Continuous (саме зараз) за словами-підказками.

theory.text: Порівняй: **I play** football on Sundays. — **I am playing** football now. В українській ми кажемо однаково «граю», а в англійській час обираємо за змістом: це звичка чи дія, що відбувається в цю мить?

theory.title: Два часи поруч
head: Present Simple
Present Continuous
rows: every day, always, usually, often, sometimes, never, on Mondays
now, at the moment, right now, Look!

items.ex: I walk to school every day.
Mum is cooking at the moment.

theory.title: Один хлопчик, два часи
theory.text:
Sam usually **plays** football after school. (звичка)
But today it is raining, so he **is playing** a computer game now. (дія зараз)

lines.text: Hi, Sam! Do you play tennis every day?
No, I play tennis on Mondays. What are you doing now?

theory.text: Дивись на слово-підказку: every day, usually, always — Present Simple. Now, at the moment, Look! — Present Continuous.

exercises.q: Який час у реченні: He usually goes to school at 8?
exercises.explain: Слово usually — зазвичай, тому Present Simple.

Present Simple: I get up at 7 every day.
We never watch television in the morning.
Present Continuous: They are playing at the moment.

exercises.text: I {play} football every day. I {am playing} football now. She {is reading} at the moment.
exercises.hint: Подивись на слова every day / now / at the moment.

options: She is going to school every day.
She goes to school every day.

exercises.text: I usually get up at seven. But today I am sleeping at the moment.

items.text: I am doing my homework every day.
My dad works in the office on weekdays.

homework.text: He usually {plays} chess. Now he {is playing} a game. We {go} to the park on Sundays.

homework.q: Яке слово підходить до Present Continuous?
Напиши 2 речення про те, що ти робиш щодня, і 2 — про те, що робиш зараз.
homework.sample: I get up at 7 every day. I usually have breakfast at 7:30. Now I am writing. I am sitting at my desk.

reflection: Які слова допомагають обрати Present Simple?
